task: Reverse-mode autodiff over matrices (Mat/Node/GradCheck) plus a seeded tanh MLP trained on XOR, verified by literal gradients and finite-difference checks
reasoning_summary: Wrote the design and 30 tests first: hand-derived literal gradients per op, finite-difference checks of every op and composed graphs with sharing, a 200000-node chain, and XOR training. Backward uses an iterative topological order, resets intermediate grads per pass and accumulates leaf grads. A 13-mutant pass exposed one test gap (Mat.approx accepted NaN), fixed by making approx reject NaN.
